checklist.criterion: Documents actual behavior, not just types: The JSDoc explains the exponential-backoff retry behavior in prose, not just parameter type restatements
Documents the exhaustion case: The comment states that the last error is thrown (not swallowed) once `maxAttempts` is reached
`@param` entries add information beyond the type: Each `@param` explains role or behavior (e.g. what `baseDelayMs` scales, what counts as an attempt), not just the parameter's type in words
Includes a realistic `@example`: A `@example` block shows a plausible call site with real-looking arguments
No pure type-restatement noise: No `@param` line consists only of the parameter's type re-stated in words with no further detail
